messages:
maya: Kicking off multi-region window/tilt sweep for mosaic-13b bring-up + quant variant. Focus: batch_window_ms, max_batch_tokens, fairness_tilt across us-east / eu-west / ap-south. Will run H100/A100 comparisons and a q4f16 vs q8_0 run.

chris: Baseline for reference: batch_window_ms=8, max_batch_tokens=1024, fairness_tilt=0.5, model=fp16. p95/us-east=58ms, p99=120ms, throughput=720 tok/s (H100). 

linh: Quick heads up from eu-west initial run on A100: p95=98ms, p99=220ms, throughput~610 tok/s. AP-south sees higher p99 (300-360ms) likely network+hot-starts.

maya: Running first sweep:
```bash
run_bench --model mosaic-13b-q4f16 --regions us-east,eu-west,ap-south \
  --gpus H100,A100 --batch_window_ms 6,12,20 \
  --max_batch_tokens 1024,2048 --fairness_tilt 0.3,0.7 \
  --warmup 300 --samples 1000 --out s3://rwd-perf/mosaic-sweep/run-1945612345.json
```

perf-bot: Sweep started (id=run-1945612345). Will post incremental summaries every 10m. :robot_face: 

alex: FYI kernel override suggestion: prefer flash_attn_v2 for H100 runs; fallback to cudnn-optimized matmul for A100. We saw a 12-18% tail improvement last month when forcing v2 on short-seq workloads.

chris: Early numbers for batch_window_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=2048, fairness_tilt=0.7 on H100/us-east: p95=64ms, p99=140ms, throughput=820 tok/s. EU (A100) throughput down to 590 tok/s, p99=235ms. AP-south p99 spikes to ~380ms. Tilt helps fairness (reduced variance across tenants) but costs ~5-7% throughput.

linh: Noted tradeoffs: increasing max_batch_tokens improves throughput but increases tail in APAC. Suspect prefix cache warmup and kernel selection interplay. Also q4f16 looks OK quality-wise on our eval set (delta ROUGE ~0.5) but need more coverage.

maya: Action items: (1) try kernel override on A100 for short-seq paths, (2) add a pass with batch_window_ms=9 and tilt=0.6, (3) run full eval on q4f16 vs fp16 for safety net. I'll schedule runs and tag results.

chris: +1. Can someone check Dedicated capacity sizing if we take the tilt into prod? We should model throughput loss vs reserved GPUs.

linh: I'll run a quick sizing calc: if tilt reduces throughput 6% on average, need ~7-8% more reserved H100 headroom for same SLA. Will post numbers.

perf-bot: Partial summary (after 45m): H100 median latency stable, best p99 in us-east with flash_attn_v2. A100 benefits from kernel override on short sequences: ~10% p99 improvement. Full JSON report: s3://rwd-perf/mosaic-sweep/run-1945612345-summary.json

maya: Thanks. Let's regroup after the ap-south focused warmup tests finish. I'll drop a short thread with the eval-quality deltas and a proposed canary rollout config. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for mosaic-13b-q4f16 on us-east (10% traffic) pending QA sign-off.
